title: Korean data-protection enforcement datasets: PIPC sanction decisions, dispute mediation, civil damages judgments and commencement dates
description:
Four tables covering how Korea's personal data laws are enforced, published as plain CSV so they can be cited, checked and reused.

Contents. (1) Sanction decisions published by the Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC); (2) disputes resolved by the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee; (3) civil judgments awarding or refusing damages for data breaches; (4) Korean statutes and subordinate rules with future commencement dates.

Method. The tables are built by reading the underlying decisions and judgments rather than the press releases. Extraction is programmatic except for a small number of hand-classified columns. Each row carries a stable anchor and a link to the original document.

Scope and limits. Only documents the issuing body has actually published are counted. The Commission anonymises many respondents, so any count broken down by company is a lower bound rather than a census. Cases known only from a press release are held separately and their amounts are not added to the totals. Accuracy is not guaranteed; verify against the original document before relying on an individual case.

Documentation. Column headings are in Korean; the README and the source pages carry English documentation. The live tables, which are updated as the collectors run, are at https://datalaw.kr/ .
